generation_default_options.note: Five-option construction is the default for question generation

live_exam_fixed_option_count.note: Official 2024 technical documentation described 3–5 response options since 2020. Current post-2025 specification does not explicitly confirm every live MCCQE item must have exactly 5 options.

clinical_stem_required.description: Clear clinical stem presenting a realistic scenario

explicit_lead_in_required.description: Clear lead-in question (e.g., 'Which of the following is most likely?')

homogeneous_options.description: Options should be homogeneous in category, form, and length

plausible_distractors.description: Distractors should be plausible and represent common misconceptions or reasonable alternative answers

best_answer_present.description: One option must clearly be the best answer

avoid_implausible_distractors.description: Avoid obviously incorrect options that do not test clinical reasoning

common_misconceptions.description: Common misconceptions and related but incorrect diagnoses make useful distractors

clinical_decision_focus.description: Focus on clinical decision-making ability, not isolated facts

candidate_skill_level.value: Medical student completing Canadian medical degree

free_practice_material.note: 55 free MCC-style practice questions are available from MCC. Use these for style calibration only. Do not copy, reproduce, reconstruct, or closely paraphrase them.

data_integrity_notes: Item style profile derived from MCC public item-writing guidance and official examination specifications. All rules are sourced from official MCC documentation or verified from official free practice materials.
